hooks.notes: list/list.context.ts: density, dividers, marker style and edge compensation for the rows.

differences.text: The semantic list is an inner <ul>/<ol> with an explicit role="list" in the shadow root, and the rows are slotted custom elements whose hosts are listitems (ElementInternals). The host carries no role; aria-label, aria-labelledby and other aria-* on the host are delegated to the inner list, and a visible header always names it. Upstream rendered <ul>/<ol>/<li> in one tree and spread props onto the <ul>.

Edge compensation reads the container padding from the private custom properties --_container-padding-inline-start and --_container-padding-inline-end (upstream --container-padding-inline-*, published by Layout containers). Layout containers must publish these names (see requests).

Numbered lists count with a CSS counter reset by the list (start - 1) and incremented by each row's marker through the flat tree; the `start` attribute is also emitted on the <ol> for parity. There is no header wrapper element: the host is the column.
Rows hover with the Tecton table-row hover fill through tct-item (components.ts `list-item`); the divider uses --color-border and divided rows are flush rectangles.

differences.text: The row is composed from tct-item inside the row's shadow root, and its host is the listitem (ElementInternals). Selection is aria-current on the host (a listitem cannot be aria-selected); an aria-current attribute wins. Interactive behaviour, truncation and the click contract are tct-item's (ITEM-01 to ITEM-07).

Markers are slotted into the item's marker slot as direct flex children: a bullet or ring (6px, --color-text-primary) or a CSS counter number, aligned to the first line's baseline. They are hidden from assistive technology.

core.list-item.notes: See core.list. Parts: list-item (the painted row, re-exported from the item's `item` part) and item.
